text:
Sam: globex trial POC started stress tests and we're seeing lots of 429s from /v1/generate. Demo in ~8 hours. Can eng take a look?

Priya: Need a failing X-Request-ID and the response headers. Also confirm if calls are streaming or non-streaming.

globex-dev: example request and response: `X-Request-ID: rq_f7e3a1`
Retry-After: 1
X-Redwood-Route-Limit: 5000
X-Redwood-Route-Remaining: 0
X-Redwood-Tenant-Remaining: 12000
{"error":"rate_limit_exceeded","message":"route burst exhausted"}`

Sam: Route remaining shows zero while tenant has headroom. They didn't change anything in our config.

Jon: Sounds like per-route burst window exhaustion. Are their clients firing many tiny parallel calls?

globex-dev: yes — single page app issues 15 parallel card requests on load, each ~90 tokens.

Priya: That equals ~1350 tokens nearly instantly. If route burst window is 5s at 1000 tokens, that'll trip. Two quick fixes: reduce client concurrency (3-4) and add jitter, or we can do a temporary route burst bump. What's acceptable for cost?

Kei: For an immediate demo, approve a short (6h) bump to 5000 tokens/5s. We'll monitor. Longer term we should add a Console hint about SPA patterns.

Taylor: @globex-dev share tenant id and route name so I can file the change and show estimated cost.

globex-dev: tenant_id tn_globex_2, route /v1/generate (model=open-7b). failing request rq_f7e3a1.

Jon: Applying 6h override now and setting alert if route remaining < 25%. Change ID ch_4412.

ops-bot: change-request tn_globex_2:route-bump -> APPROVED by Kei. Change ID: ch_4412.

Jon: Bump active. Monitoring link: https://console.redwood.example/tenants/tn_globex_2/usage/route/v1%2Fgenerate

globex-dev: After we limited concurrency to 4 with 100-300ms jitter the 429s stopped. Demo went OK — thanks.

Priya: Follow-ups: (1) add runbook note about route vs tenant buckets, (2) add a Console tooltip for SPA concurrency, (3) consider an automatic short-duration demo grace for trial tenants.

Sam: I'll own the post-demo writeup and cost note. Appreciate the quick help! :rocket:
